controls.description: Identify possible personal information in data or systems.
Limit collection, access, and processing to what is needed.
Remove or obscure sensitive values before disclosure or use.
Replace sensitive values with non-sensitive tokens where appropriate.
Protect data confidentiality in storage or transit using cryptographic controls.
Restrict access according to authorized roles and needs.
Record security-relevant actions with suitable integrity and access safeguards.
Define and enforce retention and deletion practices.
Document data sources, transformations, destinations, and responsible systems.
Review and govern disclosures to external parties.
